_comment: SYNTHETIC. Generated by resource/scripts/synthesise_gas_data.py. Not metered data: no public dataset carries half-hourly domestic gas volumes, so this is constructed from published aggregates and real weather. Do not present it as an observed household.

method.annualEnergyBasis: Ofgem medium gas Typical Domestic Consumption Value

shares.source: DESNZ Energy Consumption in the UK, Table U3, natural gas columns, 2024

method.pairedWith: The electricity fixture's household, chosen because it is gas heated and so leaves room for a boiler
